name: AssetType

name: Blocks

name: Buyers
description: The name of the buyer(s).

name: BuyersAsReported
description: The name of the buyer(s) as disclosed in the public domain.

name: BuyersFinancialAdvisors
description: Financial Advisors of the buyers.

name: BuyersHeadquarters
description: The country headquarters of the buyers.

name: BuyersLegalAdvisors
description: Legal Advisors of the buyers.

name: BuyersPeerGroup
description: This field Specifies which Peer Group did the Buyers belong to, Options include - Public E&P, Private, Private Equity backed, etc.

name: BuyersRegionsOfOrigin

name: BuyerTicker
description: The ticker symbol for the buyer at the time of the transaction.

name: CanadaProvince
description: The Canadian province where the transacted assets are located.

name: CashFlowOrEBITDA_MM
description: Description of Cash Flow or EBITDA- often includes the pertaining time period or assumptions.

name: CashFlowOrEBITDAComment
description: Cash Flow or EBITDA associated with the transaction reported in $ millions.

name: CashFlowOrEBITDAMultiple
description: Deal value divided by Cash Flow or EBITDA.

name: CashFlowOrEBITDAMultipleComment
description: Description of Cash Flow or EBITDA used to arrive at the multiple- often includes relevant time period or assumptions.

name: Counties
description: The Counties where the transacted assets are located.

name: Dataset
description: Classified as USA Upstream, Canada Upstream, International Upstream, Midstream, Downstream, OFS, LNG, Power &Utilities based on energy vertical or location (for upstream transactions).

name: DateAnnounced
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: Date that the transaction is publicly announced.

name: DateClosed
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: The Date that the deal closed.

name: DateEffective
description: The financial effective date of the transaction.

name: DateModified
description: The date that a particular transaction was updated by a market research analyst.

name: DealHighlights
description: A good summary of the transaction, that provides an overview of the assets, agreement, structure and financing of the transaction.

name: DealID
description: A unique key associated with every transaction.

name: DealInsight
description: In-depth analysis and commentary for a particular transaction, often includes transaction comps and comparable transactions maps.

name: DealInsightMap
description: Map image used in the respective Deal Insight for the transaction..

name: DealStatus
description: The current status of the deal classified as announced, closed, or terminated.

name: DealType
description: The type of deal based on following criteria: Acreage - Asset for sale expected to have >70% of value is attributed to acreage (and therefore not production); Corporate - Buyer acquires another company or stake in a company; Farm In/Farm Out - Deals where the buyer will earn a working interest that isn't subject to return hurdles and is generally participating more in drilling risk/upside; JV - Partnership done with some kind of promoted basis, most commonly seen with drillco structures where there are return hurdles and substantial cutbacks in the buyer's working interest; Property - Asset for sale where at least 30% of expected deal value is attributed to production (this value is derived from our production multiples for oil, NGLs, and gas, multiplied by the production of the deal); Royalty - Deals for sale in which royalty interests are being marketed, includes ORRIs; VPP - Volumetric Production Payment - Deal for sale in which an interest in a specific volume of production from an asset is being marketed.

name: DealValueCash_MM
description: Amount of Cash consideration paid by the buyer to the seller in the total deal value.

name: DealValueComplexityBarrelDollarPerBBL
description: Deal value divided by Refinery Complexity (metric only given when Segment = Refining).

name: DealValueDailyCapacityDollarPerBBL
description: Deal value divided by total refining capacity of transacted assets (metric only given when Segment = Refining).

name: DealValueDebt_MM
description: Amount of Debt assumed in transaction as part of the total deal value.

name: DealValueEquity_MM
description: Amount of Equity involved in the total deal value.

name: DealValueFCCEquiv
description: Deal value divided by Fluid Catalytic Cracking conversion capacity of a refinery.

name: DealValueNetDebtAssumed_MM
description: Seller's net debt assumed by the Buyer in an acquisition (reported by company, or calculated from financials statements)

name: DealValueOther_MM
description: Portion of deal value not attributable to cash, equity, debt, working capital. Examples include noncontrolling interests, value of carry received in a transaction, certain P&A liabilities, etc.

name: DealValuePerAcreage
description: Deal value divided by total net acres acquired or sometimes total net acres of acquired in a particular play.

name: DealValueProductionBOEPerDay
description: Deal value divided by daily production acquired.

name: DealValueProvedReservesBOE
description: Deal value divided by proved reserves acquired.

name: DealValueRCIRefining
description: Deal value divided by the Replacement Cost Index of transacted refining assets.

name: DealValueRCITerminal
description: Deal value divided by the Replacement Cost Index of transacted terminal assets.

name: DealValueStorageCapacityDollarPerBBL
description: Deal value divided by total storage capacity of transacted assets (metric only given when Segment = Storage).

name: DealValueWorkingCapital_MM
description: Working capital deficit/surplus of the seller assumed by buyer. Calculated as current assets minus current liabilities.

name: DeletedDate
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: Date the record was deleted. *Deleted records should not be used in an analysis.

name: DollarPer2PBOE
description: Deal value associated to a unit of 2P BOE of Reserves (after royalties).

name: DollarPer2PBOEWI
description: Deal value associated to a unit of 2P BOE of Reserves (before royalties).

name: DollarPer2PMCFE
description: Deal value associated to a unit of 2P Mcfe of Reserves (after royalties).

name: DollarPer2PMCFEWI
description: Deal value associated to a unit of 2P Mcfe of Reserves (before royalties).

name: DollarPer3PBOE
description: Deal value associated to a unit of 3P BOE of Reserves (after royalties).

name: DollarPer3PBOEWI
description: Deal value associated to a unit of 3P BOE of Reserves (before royalties).

name: DollarPer3PMCFE
description: Deal value associated to a unit of 3P Mcfe of Reserves (after royalties).

name: DollarPer3PMCFEWI
description: Deal value associated to a unit of 3P Mcfe of Reserves (before royalties).

name: DollarPerAcreDollarPerSurfaceAcre
description: Deal value associated to each net acre, this is done by first assigning a value to PDP (Production) and then assigning the remaining value to acreage and dividing by net acres.

name: DollarPerbblLiquidsStorageCapacity
description: Deal value divided by liquids storage capacity (no valuation done if other non-liquids storage assets are transacted).

name: DollarPerContingentBOE
description: Deal value associated to a unit of Contingent BOE of Reserves (after royalties).

name: DollarPerContingentBOEWI
description: Deal value associated to a unit of Contingent BOE of Reserves (before royalties).

name: DollarPerContingentMCFE
description: Deal value associated to a unit of Contingent Mcfe of Reserves (after royalties).

name: DollarPerContingentMCFEWI
description: Deal value associated to a unit of Contingent Mcfe of Reserves (before royalties).

name: DollarPerDailyBBLLiquidsGatheringCapacity
description: Deal value divided by liquids gathering capacity (no valuation done if other non-liquids gathering assets are transacted).

name: DollarPerDailyBBLLiquidsPipelineCapacity
description: Deal value divided by liquids pipeline transportation capacity (no valuation done if other non-liquids pipeline assets are transacted).

name: DollarPerDailyBOE
description: Deal value associated to a unit of Daily BOE of Production after royalties (deal value divided by daily production if all value is allocated to production. If deal value is allocated beyond produciton (i.e. acreage, midstream assets, etc.) then it is a blended metric based on Enverus production multiples).

name: DollarPerDailyBOEWI
description: Deal value associated to a unit of Daily BOE of Production before royalties (deal value divided by daily production if all value is allocated to production. If deal value is allocated beyond produciton (i.e. acreage, midstream assets, etc.) then it is a blended metric based on Enverus production multiples).

name: DollarPerDailyMCFE
description: Deal value divided by natural gas gathering and processing capacity (no valuation done if other non-gas pipeline assets are transacted).

name: DollarPerDailyMCFEWI
description: Deal value divided by natural gas pipeline transportation capacity (no valuation done if other non-gas pipeline assets are transacted).

name: DollarPerDailyMCFGasGatheringandProcessing
description: Deal value associated to a unit of Daily Mcfe of Production (after royalties).

name: DollarPerDailyMCFGasPipeline
description: Deal value associated to a unit of Daily Mcfe of Production (before royalties).

name: DollarPerLocation
description: Acreage value associated to a unit of Net Risked Remaining Locations (drilling inventory acquired in the transaction); acreage value divided by Net Unrisked Remaining Locations.

name: DollarPerMCFGasStorageCapacity
description: Deal value divided by natural gas storage capacity (no valuation done if other non-gas storage assets are transacted).

name: DollarPerMWGenerationCapacity
description: Deal value divided by generation capacity.

name: DollarPerProvedBOE
description: Deal value associated to a unit of Proved BOE of Reserves (after royalties).

name: DollarPerProvedBOEWI
description: Deal value associated to a unit of Proved BOE of Reserves (before royalties).

name: DollarPerProvedMCFE
description: Deal value associated to a unit of Proved Mcfe of Reserves (after royalties).

name: DollarPerProvedMCFEWI
description: Deal value associated to a unit of Proved Mcfe of Reserves (before royalties).

name: DUCCount

name: ENVBasin

name: ENVClosingStory
description: A&D Transactions Closing Story Write-Up.

name: ENVNarrative
description: A&D Transactions Write-Up.

name: ENVOperatorBuyer
description: Buyer. Data has been normalized and standardized by Enverus to aggregate into single operator names as well as roll subsidiaries up to the parent company where public data is disclosed.

name: ENVOperatorBuyerTicker

name: ENVOperatorSeller

name: ENVOperatorSellerTicker

name: ENVRegion

name: ExchangeRateDate

name: ReservesReportedBy
description: The Entity who reported the reserve figures.

name: ReservoirEngineering
description: The engineering firm that did the reservoir engineering studies

name: ResourceType
description: Description of whether the assets are conventional or unconventional.

name: RoyaltyRate_PCT
description: Royalty rate acquired by the buyer.

name: RP2PReservesNet
description: 2P Reserves divided by annual production (barrels of Daily Production multiplied by 365).

name: RP2PReservesWI
description: 2P Reserves divided by annual production (barrels of Daily Production multiplied by 365).

name: RPProvedDeveloped
description: Proved Developed Reserves divided by annual production (barrels of Daily Production multiplied by 365).

name: RPProvedDevelopedWI
description: Proved Developed Reserves divided by annual production (barrels of Daily Production multiplied by 365).

name: RPProvedReserves
description: Proved Reserves divided by annual production (barrels of Daily Production multiplied by 365).

name: RPProvedReservesWI
description: Proved Reserves divided by annual production (barrels of Daily Production multiplied by 365).

name: SalesValueBasisRefinery_MM
description: Sales Value Basis allocated to refineries.

name: SalesValueBasisTerminal_MM
description: Sales Value Basis allocated to terminals.

name: SecondaryCountry
description: The secondary country where the transacted assets are located.

name: SecondaryRegion
description: The secondary global region where the transacted assets are located.

name: Segment
description: Used to categorize assets across non-upstream datasets (Midstream, Downstream, OFS, Power & Utilities, LNG) with different options for each.

name: Sellers
description: The name of the seller(s).

name: SellersAsReported
description: The name of the seller(s) as disclosed in the public domain

name: SellersFinancialAdvisors
description: Financial Advisors of the sellers

name: SellersHeadquarters
description: The country headquarters of the sellers

name: SellersLegalAdvisors
description: Legal Advisors of the sellers

name: SellersPeerGroup
description: This field Specifies which Peer Group did the Sellers belong to, Options include - Public, Private, Private Equity backed etc

name: SellersRegionsOfOrigin
description: Global region of seller determined by its headquarters

name: SellersTicker
description: The ticker symbol for the seller at the time of the transaction.

name: ShapeFileType
description: Description of shape file classified as geometry or location point.

name: StateCode
description: State abbreviation for the states where the transacted assets are located; if there is county information then each state code is specific to each county listed therefore there can be repeating state codes.

name: StateCountyGrouped
description: The county and the state where the transacted assets are located.

name: States
description: The states where the transacted assets are located.

name: StorageCapacity_MMbbl
description: Total storage capacity for refined products of the transacted assets.

name: SupplyDeliveryModes
description: Description of the means in which the assets supply/deliver products.

name: TerminalType
description: Description of products held in a storage terminal; classified as crude oil, refined products, or crude oil & refined products.

name: TransactionNotes
description: Quick one liner highlighting key points/details or additional info related to the transaction.

name: TransactionType
description: The type of deal for sale based on following criteria:New Exploration Awards - licences awarded by the Government; Corporate M&A - Buyer acquires another company or stake in a company; Exploration blocks previously awarded - licences have already been awarded by the government, but they have not been developed in any way; Discoveries, Fields under Development, Producing fields - Depends on the phase of developement of the acreage (discovery is least developed, producing fields is most developed).

name: UpdatedDate
requirements: Value should be in the RFC3339 format. Example: 2021-01-01
description: Date the record was updated.

name: USSubregion
description: The US Subregion that the deal is associated with

name: ValuationNotes
description: Information on the valuation methodology for a particular transaction. Shows calculation on the breakdown of how value is allocated in a deal including details on the oil, gas and NGL multiples used to arrive at the production value

name: Value2P_MM
description: The portion of total deal value allocated to 2P Reserves

name: Value3P_MM
description: The portion of total deal value allocated to 3P Reserves

name: Value_MM
description: The total value for which the deal transacted in millions of dollars.

name: Value_MM_As_Reported
description: The total value for which the deal transacted in millions of dollars as reported in the public domain

name: ValueAcreage_MM
description: The portion of total deal value allocated to Acreage (most often caluclated as total deal value less production value)

name: ValueContingent_MM
description: The portion of total deal value allocated to Contingent Reserves

name: ValueOther_MM
description: The portion of total deal value allocated to items other than 2p Reserves, 3P Reserves, Acreage, Contingent Reserves or Proved Reserves (i.e. midstream assets)

name: ValuePDP_MM
description: The portion of total deal value allocated to Proved Reserves or often times production value which is calculated using flowing production multiples for oil, NGLs, and gas, respectively.

name: ValueTotal_MM
description: Sum of all Consideration Paid data fields.

name: WellListDownload
description: Excel file containing list of well APIs included in the transaction.

name: UniqueDealID
description: A unique key associated with every transaction.
